name: yellow-prompt
description: Draws your own prompts in color (yellow by default), in the prompt box and in the transcript

textColor.title: Text color
textColor.description: color of your prompts: a name (yellow, cyan, magenta, green...) or a hex value like #f5c518

borderColor.title: Border color
borderColor.description: color of the box around your sent prompts: a name or a hex value

borderStyle.title: Border style
borderStyle.description: Shape of the box around your sent prompts; none draws no box
